title: Getting value from a ghost card
target: How to use a ghost card in TCG Card Shop Simulator by choosing the day its single effect actually helps, instead of holding it because it sounds rare.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A ghost card in your collection
Some idea of where your money is coming from today

steps.do: Read which effect the card carries before deciding it is a good one.
steps.because: a ghost card holds a single effect from a fixed list (GhostCardEffect)

steps.do: On a day you are opening packs, favour an effect that touches what you pull.
steps.because: foil chance is one of the effects on the list (FoilChance)

steps.do: On a day you are selling, favour an effect that touches customers.
steps.because: customer spending power and collector odds are effects of their own (CustomerSpendingPower)

steps.do: If your time is short, an effect that shortens play table rounds is worth as much as money.
steps.because: play table time appears on the effect list (ReducePlayTableTime)

steps.do: Do not read a booster effect as though it were a ghost card effect.
steps.because: booster effects are tracked in a list of their own (EBoosterEffect)

commonMistakes: Assuming every ghost card is an upgrade.
Chasing a money effect on a day you are opening packs.
Confusing a booster effect with a ghost card effect.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
